perAggregateRules: Commands for one order/local sale execute in localSequence order.
A failed or conflict command blocks its dependents, not unrelated aggregates.
A lease uses compare-and-set in IndexedDB and a BroadcastChannel heartbeat; service worker and page cannot process the same command concurrently.
The server, not the device, claims canonical processing and decides replay versus conflict.
Online/offline detection is advisory; only an authenticated server response changes a command to synced.
stateTransitions: conflict->pending only after explicit resolution creates a new immutable command
forbiddenTransitions: any->deleted while a dependent command is non-terminal
